summary: No new work is submitted this turn; the merged primary interpretation already submitted is the current record and remains valid. The audit has reached a state where I can identify no further useful work within the remaining budget, and I will not manufacture experiments to consume it. Current state: one asserted defect with ten receipts, established by a witness series across ten executions and bounded by five independent controls, namely a never-removed member, the participant form kept as an outgoing voter, the running clock under PreVote and CheckQuorum, the admission of a pending invocation by a leader change, and a read-index boundary showing the harm is confined to the MsgProp entry points; two bounded safety negatives from a randomized exploration with membership changes injected, each stating its scope and the combination it deliberately did not sample; two retained resynchronization branches, restart through the append path and restart requiring snapshot installation; one authority-transition control for a removed leader stepping down under StepDownOnRemoval; and per-question interpretations that carry the counterevidence, the limits and the exact receipt indices. No claim rests on anything unverified: the harness revision currently in the draft is older than the fixed artifacts of the last submitted experiments, so every executed basis is preserved as it ran. If the controller's time or budget expires now, the retained work is complete and interpretable as it stands.
